newsitem.title: UK: London U.S. stocks mixed to weaker, Cisco falls.
newsitem.headline: London U.S. stocks mixed to weaker, Cisco falls.

text.p: U.S. stocks traded here were mixed in quiet trading on Wednesday following through from small losses on Wall Street at last night's close and with little to guide the market strongly in either direction, dealers said.
"People are nervous that a big decline is in the offing after the strong rises recently and we expect a small drop on Wall Street at the start today," said one dealer.
Cisco Systems was trading at around New York after-hours levels, about $2 down from the close at $80. The company came out with earnings which disappointed some market expectations, dealers said.
Fourth quarter earnings of $0.55 a share compared with unpublished forecasts of up to $0.60 a share, New York dealers said.
Dealers here gave Intel as a bellwether on today's market. The stock traded $5/8 down at $99-1/8.
"We've been led by the hi-techs of late and if you could tell when their run was to break you could gauge the whole market," said one.
